thread:
Alex: Heads-up — ACME reported p99 latency spikes after last night's fp8 quant profile rollout on redwood-llama-3b. Customer saw 800–1200ms p99 on long sequences (>1024). please triage.
Marta: Got it. Do we have a quick repro? is it across all regions or just us-east-1?
Alex: Only us-east-1 so far. Repro steps from ACME: send a 1.2k token request using chat.generate with streaming off. They sent an example prompt.
Ryan: Looking at runtime logs now. I'm seeing tail latencies that match:
```
2026-03-16T21:03:14Z INFO request_id=abc123 model=redwood-llama-3b variant=fp8 seq_len=128 p50=20ms p95=150ms p99=500ms
2026-03-16T21:03:15Z INFO request_id=def456 model=redwood-llama-3b variant=fp8 seq_len=1200 p50=120ms p95=600ms p99=1100ms
```
Ryan: Also noticing kurtosis on kernel scheduling logs for large KV-cache allocations.
Jessica: Are quality regressions reported too or purely latency?
Alex: Customer says quality is fine for now, they care about latency/SLO. they'd accept fp16 temporarily.
Marta: Quick mitigation options: 1) route ACME to fp16 variant, 2) force fp8->fp16 fallback for seq_len>512, 3) roll back fp8 profile globally. Prefer per-customer routing to avoid rollback.
Alex: Can we toggle routing per-tenant immediately? what's the command?
Ryan: Ops can add a routing override. Example: `redwoodctl routes set acme-inc model=redwood-llama-3b variant=fp16 priority=high --until 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z`
ops-bot: @Ryan noted — creating a transient override ticket (#OVR-2026-58).
deploy-bot: Canary rollback job queued: rollback-fp8-2026-03-16 by Ryan. ETA 6m.
Marta: Before rollback, can we test a smaller fix: runtime patch to disable fp8 kernels for seq_len > 1024 and keep fp8 for short sequences? That would preserve perf for short requests.
Ryan: I can push a hotfix branch to runtime that gates fp8 kernel selection with `if (seq_len > 1024) use_fp16();` and build a canary image.
Jessica: Customer prefers explicit fp16 routing to control costs. they also asked about credits for the SLA miss.
Alex: We'll offer 1-day pro-rated credits and the per-tenant routing as immediate remedy. engineering should prioritize the hotfix for broader safety.
Marta: Repro plan for eng-ml: 1) run ACME's 1.2k token prompt on canary runtime with fp8 enabled, 2) run same on canary with the fp8-gate patch, 3) compare p95/p99 and kernel time breakdown, 4) if gate helps >30% p99 reduction, promote to canary rollout.
Ryan: I'm starting step 1 now on a canary node in us-east-1. attaching perf snapshot in 5.
Ryan: Snapshot: p99=1120ms, kernel_wait=650ms, kv_alloc=~18MB per request.
Marta: Snapshot with gate applied: p99=320ms, kernel_wait=80ms, kv_alloc same but using fp16 kernels drastically reduced stall time.
Alex: Nice. Can we automate fallback for sequences > 1024 while we do a full profile re-calibration?
Ryan: I'll add a runtime flag `--fp8-max-seq=1024` and push as hotfix. We'll canary that and then toggle tenant routing afterward.
ops-bot: Override applied for acme-inc: variant=fp16 until 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z by Alex.
Alex: Communications: @support to write the customer note: "We've applied a temporary route to fp16 and are rolling a safety hotfix to improve p99. We'll follow up with a timeline for fp8 re-calibration. You will receive a credit for the impacted window."
Jessica: I'll draft the note and post to ACME shortly.
Marta: Postmortem notes: suspected cause = fp8 kernel scheduling for large KV cache sizes is causing lock contention on the GPU streaming queue. Action items: 1) re-calibrate fp8 profile for long-context workloads, 2) add automated workload-level safety gate to model profiles, 3) add perf regression alert on model variant level (p95/p99 divergence > 2x).
Alex: Assigning owners: Ryan -> hotfix + canary promotion; Marta -> calibration/benchmarks; Jessica -> customer comms & credits; me -> monitor SLA metrics and confirm.
Ryan: Hotfix built and deployed to canary cluster at 2750011300. Monitoring p99 now.
Ryan: Can confirm canary p99 stabilized ~300ms. pushing to 10% rollout now.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 10% cluster nodes started (rollout-id=roll-7751).
Alex: Good work team. Keep updates concise in this thread. once stable, we'll remove the per-tenant override and publish the calibration notes in eng-ml. :thumbsup:
Marta: I'll open a follow-up doc in eng-ml with calibration data and the new guardrails.
Jessica: Customer update sent. ACME replied : "Thanks, we see improvement. appreciate the quick action"
Alex: Closing loop — set reminder to revisit full fp8 profile in 2 weeks and measure cost delta.
